title: ChildState
description: Raw child state per ADR-004. Exactly two raw pockets: topic_mastery and interests. Capability scores are DERIVED views (topic-derived aggregation + capped direct evidence), never stored.

interests.description: Interest label -> weight 0..1. Seeded taxonomy + controlled emergence (child labels hang under seed labels). Updated by evidence EMA.

topic_mastery.description: Sparse map: topic id (mt_...) -> mastery record. Absent topics fall back to an age-based prior; they are not stored.

confidence.description: Grows with evidence count; scales EMA step size.

capability_direct.description: Sparse map: capability id -> direct-evidence accumulator. SECONDARY channel only (ADR-004 §4): evidence with no honest topic anchor. evidence_strength for this channel is capped at 0.5. Final capability score = topic-derived aggregate fused with this channel.
